intro: The sun falls and bounces with gravity. Rotate the tower to keep it dropping through the gaps.
namePrivacy: If you enter a name, your name and score will be public on the leaderboard. You can also play without a name.
ruleIntro: The sun falls with gravity and bounces when it hits a floor. Drag left or right to rotate the tower, bring a gap to the front, and let the sun drop through.
ruleCombo: Drop through consecutive floors without bouncing to earn an extra (streak−1)×50 points, starting with drop 2.
ruleFire: Drop through 3 floors in a row for +300 and fireball mode🔥. For 6 floors, you can smash through both floors and red danger zones.
ruleSmash: Passing a floor in fireball mode or by smashing it gives an extra +50.
ruleDanger: Landing on a red danger zone outside fireball mode ends the game.
nameHelp: You can change your name on the home screen. You can also play without a name.
readyHint: Drag left or right to rotate the tower! Guide the sun through the gap at the front and drop through 3 floors in a row for a fireball🔥.
canvasLabel: コロシャイン game screen
hint: Drag left or right to rotate the tower. Aim for the gap at the front. A streak of 3 gives you a fireball🔥. Watch out for red zones!
error: Something went wrong. Return to the home screen and try again.
shareCopyHelp: If X won't open, you can copy the text and URL and post them yourself.
copied: Copied. Check your post on X.
copyFailed: Select the text and copy it manually.
rankingFailed: Couldn't load the leaderboard. Select “Reload leaderboard” to try again.
guest: You played without a name, so this result will not be sent to the leaderboard.
pending: Your score is waiting to be sent. You can retry sending this same score.
failed: Couldn't send your score to the leaderboard. This result is being kept on this screen.
resultUnsaved: We couldn't confirm that this result was saved on your device. Do not reload; retry saving and sending it.
confirmRetire: End this run and go to the results screen?
